# thiserror Quick Reference

## Use in This Repo

- strongly typed domain and application errors
- ergonomic Display formatting and source chaining

## Preferred Patterns

- keep error enums domain-specific
- include actionable messages at boundaries
- preserve source errors with transparent wrappers

## Validation Reminders

- avoid opaque catch-all variants in domain types
- ensure conversions preserve context
- keep user-facing messages stable for API surfaces
